The motion asset's `fileModifiedAt` is now set from `dates.modifyDate` instead of `asset.fileModifiedAt`. Verify `getDates` returns the actual file modification date for the motion asset (not the parent asset's), otherwise the motion video's modification date will be wrong.

`asset.fileModifiedAt` and `asset.fileCreatedAt` may be null/undefined for some assets. Comparing them with `<` when either is undefined will yield `false` and silently pick `fileCreatedAt` (possibly undefined), which then propagates as an invalid date. Consider guarding for missing values before comparing.
